translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

content: Bi Gor Minim Aŋgñemb Omiŋal Ak

Pen yip kur par tap ayniŋbay bap ñiyiŋg aŋgyak, “Am Gor aŋgniŋep korip ak ayniŋiy, Gor nup tap simboŋgipay bind ar ak ayniŋiy ginimin. Biynimb Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan apiy nup aŋgniŋsipay gok kunep, ñin paŋg niŋnimin.

Pen biynimb Jiwda mer gok, per ap wariy mis akyaŋ mindpay rek, tip kun ak sek ma ayniŋnimin. Yenen: kiyk nep dawin yomb suŋ-tep Jerusalem timey giyiŋg mindey mindey, ñin wan tawsin tiw handret sikistiy amniŋgamb.
Yand pen, bi minim yip aŋgñemb omiŋal aŋgyoken, yikop bek band rek gok yimyiŋg, minim yip aŋgñi taŋger, ñin wan tawsin tiw handret sikistiy kun ak amniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Bi minim nup aŋgñemb omiŋal kun ak, mon oliyp bind omiŋal rek ak pen, lam omiŋal rek. Kiymiŋay Biyomb mankumb biy kond mindip ak nup woŋg giñiniŋgambiyr.
Pen biynimb gunap kuyipmiŋay timey giniŋg gey, mon maŋlaŋ meŋg miŋgan kiyk ak nimb apiy, kuyip yinek kumniŋgambay. Kuyipmiŋay nembnemb geniŋgambay, kun ak rek nep giniŋgamb.
Gor kuyipmiŋay aŋgayek woŋg nup gi dand amyiŋg, miñmon ma pikaŋ aŋger, ma pikniŋgamb; ñiŋg gok likañ tikaŋ aŋger, likañ tikniŋgamb; biynimb gok kuyip miker yerip yerip gok gaŋ aŋger, giniŋgamb.
Pen Gor minim ak aŋgñi dand amiy, day jiwrikniŋ, tap ayndik kaw kiruŋ ma tikak biyaŋ nimb winiŋgamb ak, kiymiŋay yip penpen gi dand amiy, pisnep ñaŋgayek kumniŋgayr.

Chip par omiŋal kun ak mindeniŋgayr miñmon dawin yomb lor namb siŋak. Dawin kun ak mey, Biyomb ak nup mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirikayak. Biynimb miñmon kun ak, Sodom yip, Yijip yip mindrep ma giyiŋgipay rek ak mindpay.

Pen biynimb miñmon okok keykey mindpay rek, minim keykey apay rek, wak keykey ayak rek, kuyipmiŋay yiruk niŋniŋgambay rek, chip omiŋal kun ak ma dam komnimimb aŋgey; kumniŋgayr ñin day ak tikiy, ñin omiŋal nokom sek ñaŋgayniŋgambay tip siŋak nep mindeniŋgayr.
Bi Gor minim aŋgñemb omiŋal kun ak, biynimb man ar biy ker gok kuyip, miker yomb ñiyiŋgpiyr rek, pen panj aŋgiy, tap yomb ñimbyiŋg, kamep aŋgyiŋg, tap pen ñek pen ñek gi mindeniŋgambay.
Pen ñin day ak sek, ñin omiŋal nokom sek mindiy, Gor añiŋ band ak yokek namb kuyip biyaŋ amek tikjakrik. Kun gek niŋiy, biynimb gok kuyip jel gak.
Pen minim bap, semb biyoŋ nimb kuyipmiŋay wiyr aŋgiy, suk aŋgek mey, biynimb ñaŋgep kiykmiŋay gok niŋmindyakniŋ, Gor miñmon biyoŋ amer, semb ak kuyip yiwgak.

Pen won kun siŋak nep monmon yomb sikerek ak diy, dawin yomb ak day onep anjip ak mindakniŋ, day onep wanjrem ak pikjispuk giy, biynimb sepen tawsin pikayak. Pen biynimb mindeyak gok, tap gak kun ak niŋiy pirikiy, Gor Biyomb semb biyoŋ ak nup yimb dand aranyak.
Pen niŋim! Miker yomb nind ak gak, namb ak gip, miñiy kisen ak giniŋg gisap.
Enjol Ar Ak Biykul Nuk Puŋgak

Won kun siŋak nep enjol ar ak, biykul nuk ak puŋgakniŋ, minim bap semb biyoŋ nimb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Miñiy tikiy biyomb gunap key mer: Biyomb chin ak sek, Kiyŋ yomb key yimb nuk ak sek kiyŋ mindiy, miñmon okok maŋgiysek perper kond mindeniŋgayr aŋgak.”
Pen biyomb ñin jiwiy andikiy nokom siya kiyŋ ar kiyk ak bisiŋg mindeyak gok, koŋgim yimiy jiy kuyaŋgiy, Gor nup aŋgniŋyiŋg aŋgyak:

content.text: Biyomb yimb per mindpan rek, miñiy tikiy biynimb miñmon okok
maŋgiysek kond mindpan ak mey, nip tep yimb aspun!
Biynimb miñmon okok nimb nip niŋiy kaljiw mindyiŋgipay.
Pen miñiy kuyip yiwur ñiniŋgamban ñin ak wip.
Biynimb kumyak gok kuyip, kor gep ñin ak wip ak mey; kuyip kor
giy, biynimb nip direp gipay gok, minim nip aŋgep gok, suŋ-tep
mindpay gok, nip niŋiy ñawil dipay gok, yimb sek mindpay akaŋ,
tam okok mindpay gok maŋgiysek direp giniŋgamban.
Pen biynimb monmon giy, biynimb gunap kuyip ñaŋg pikaypay gok kuyip, pen kunep timey giniŋgamban aŋgyak.”

content: Kun aŋgyakniŋ, Gor aŋgniŋep korip semb biyoŋ ak miŋgan yikiy, Gor minim mindek kes won ak miseŋ gek niŋnik. Won kun ak nep timuk añiñak diy, giw yomb sikerek ak aŋgiy, miñmon niŋgomb maŋgiy gok pikiy, monmon apiy gak.
